name: Nawabs of Bengal
events: In India, Shuja-ud-Din Muhammad Khan becomes the new Nawab of Bengal after the death of his father-in-law…
John Deane, a colonial administrator of Britain's British East India Company, returns to Calcutta (Kolkata)…
John Stackhouse is appointed by the British East India Company as the new President of the Bengal…
A garrison of the British Army in India is imprisoned in the Black Hole of Calcutta.
The British East India Company takes control of Chandannagar and forces out the French Indian administrators.
